entries.0f556a2121b15f3a: A business in which consolidated subsidiary CINC Capital Co., Ltd. uses marketing technology to provide M&A brokerage services, mainly for mid-sized and small companies, addressing sell-side needs such as business succession and business restructuring. In the fiscal year ended October 2025, no transaction was concluded and there were no net sales.
entries.4d361d85551d7e79: The business develops, sells and provides software centered on “Keywordmap” that supports research, analysis and operation in marketing. Net sales for the fiscal year ended October 2025 were ¥763 million.
entries.4f8ce462c52102b7: The company operates the information media “Marketing Native,” which leads business through marketing-oriented thinking. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.5a859a7d7f786ce5: A business that provides DX marketing solutions based on the analysis of big data. Net sales for the fiscal year ended October 2025 were ¥1,061 million.
entries.683237dc51066d84: A research, analysis and operation tool that supports data-driven use of SNS in business. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.8203c4daed23697b: A cloud-based software product that analyzes the company’s big data of Japanese keywords using natural language processing and machine learning, supporting everything from market analysis and competitor research to identifying areas for improvement. It has a subscription pricing structure with a fixed monthly fee. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.8aa58fcd11f2547a: A service in which data analysts investigate and analyze “Keywordmap” big data and other data, providing integrated support from planning digital marketing strategies and executing measures through to measuring their effects. In June 2025, the company began providing AI search optimization (GEO/LLMO) consulting services. It also provides outsourced content production and advertising operation. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.bcb9be4352f34b3d: An independent system that automatically collects M&A transaction data for listed and unlisted companies and automatically collects and analyzes data on buyer companies. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.bfda5c75f631c83a: A company that, based on big data analysis, provides the marketing research and analysis tool "Keywordmap," DX consulting and M&A brokerage.
entries.fab382967554fe58: A service that supports the resolution of client issues together with marketing professionals with whom the company has partnerships. The amount is not separately disclosed.
